step1_analysis.description: The circuit appears to be a dynamic comparator or latch used in a sigma-delta modulator. The input stage (XM1-XM6) sums the differential inputs into a common node P, which biases the tail currents (XM7, XM8) of a cross-coupled latch (XM2, XM9, XM12, XM13). Note: The latch outputs (OUTP, OUTN) are completely isolated from the input signal in this specific netlist extraction, meaning it acts as a static bistable element whose tail current is modulated by the input common-mode.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 140-W 88-dB Audio Sigma-Delta Modulator in 90-nm CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the circuit.

paper_reported.value: 140 uW (Note: OCR says 140 W, likely uW)

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V and default W/L=5u/0.5u, the input branches and latch tail currents will draw significant current. I_branch ≈ 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.9-0.42)^2 ≈ 310uA. Total current ≈ 1.5mA. Power = 1.5mA * 1.8V = 2.7mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher than paper due to 1.8V supply vs 1V, and potentially larger default transistor sizing than the optimized 90nm design.

gain_to_bias_node.description: AC gain from the input (INP) to the internal summing node P.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_in * R_out. Node P is loaded by diode-connected XM14 (gm ≈ 50u * 10 * 0.5 ≈ 250uS). Gain ≈ 1 to 5 V/V (0 to 14 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected load severely limits the voltage gain at node P. The 88 dB reported in the paper refers to the overall ADC SNR, not this specific stage's gain.

bandwidth.description: -3dB bandwidth at the internal node P.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * R_out * C_out). R_out is low (~4kOhm) due to diode connection. C_out is parasitic (~50fF). BW ≈ 1 / (2 * pi * 4k * 50f) ≈ 800 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low impedance at node P pushes the pole to high frequencies, easily supporting the 57 MHz clock rate.

output_swing.description: Maximum voltage swing of the cross-coupled latch outputs.

sky130_expected.calculation: The PMOS cross-coupled pair pulls up to VDD (1.8V), and the NMOS pair pulls down to the tail nodes (N3, N6) which are near GND.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard latch behavior provides full logic levels.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain to the internal node P, and transient output swing of the latch. A tiny symmetry-breaking current is injected to ensure the isolated latch resolves to a known state.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Dynamic Latch / Comparator
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1b=5u L_xm1b=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2a=5u L_xm2a=0.5u
.param W_xm1a=5u L_xm1a=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm2b=5u L_xm2b=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
VC1 C1 0 DC 1.8

* Inject a tiny current to break symmetry so the isolated latch resolves
I_break_sym OUTP 0 DC 1u

XM1B N7 INN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1b} w={W_xm1b}
XM2 OUTP OUTN N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 P P N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2A N9 C1 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2a} w={W_xm2a}
XM1A N8 INP GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1a} w={W_xm1a}
XM6 P P N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 P GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N6 P GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 OUTN OUTP N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM2B N10 C1 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2b} w={W_xm2b}
XM11 P C1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 OUTN OUTP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 OUTP OUTN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 P P VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power_dc = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power_dc

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 1G
let gain_db = vdb(P)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(max_gain-3) fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 100p 20n
meas tran v_outp_max max v(OUTP)
meas tran v_outn_max max v(OUTN)
meas tran v_outp_min min v(OUTP)
meas tran v_outn_min min v(OUTN)
let swing_outp = v_outp_max - v_outp_min
let swing_outn = v_outn_max - v_outn_min
print swing_outp swing_outn

quit
.endc
